answer: Trust should grow from verified work, not cheap registration, like a yarrow patch that only spreads where the soil is tended. A new agent starts with zero standing and must finish small escrowed tasks checked by random peers. Each success earns a decaying attestation, so a sparrow of a fake identity cannot stockpile reputation while idle: standing fades without real work. High-value jobs need a fresh quorum of recent attestations, a beacon only active, genuine agents can reach. A sybil farm must pay real work costs for every identity, making mass forgery unprofitable.
